FloatingBox variants
|-- Shared display state
|   |-- DisplayNodeBase: id, childIds, expansion, geometryPolicy, expandedGeometry?
|   |-- Geometry uses unscaled CSS pixels in canvas or viewport space.
|   `-- DisplayState: rootIds: string[]; nodes: Record<string, FloatingPane>
|-- Captured selection and projections
|   |-- SelectionRegion: kind: 'selection'; sourceBoxId; sourceContentId; sourceAscii
|   |   `-- Captures panel context; SelectionState alone manages membership.
|   |-- ProjectedPane: kind: 'projection'; title; projectionId?; revision IDs?
|   |   |-- content.kind: 'call-tree' | 'compaction' | 'source-code' | 'code-panel'
|   |   `-- Source metadata and panel payloads depend on the selected variant.
|   `-- Live scrolling belongs to SourcePaneViewState; scroll fields are checkpoints.
|-- Conversation and detail
|   |-- ConversationPane: thread, draft, presentation, canvasAnchor
|   |   `-- The semantic bubble anchor is independent of panel presentation.
|   `-- DetailPane: kind: 'detail'; title: string; ascii: string; sectionId?: string
|-- State mutation helpers
|   |-- addDisplayNode(state, node, ownerId?); removeDisplayNode(state, id)
|   |   `-- Maintain parent membership and remove descendants together.
|   |-- setExpansion(state, id, expansion)
|   |   `-- Retains expanded geometry for restoration after collapse.
|   `-- updateDisplayGeometry(...); measureDisplayNode(...)
|       `-- Share geometry updates; expanded fixed-size panes reject measurement.
`-- Derived arrows and placement
    |-- FloatingBox = FloatingPane | FloatingBoxArrow
    |   `-- Arrows derive from document.edges and are absent from DisplayState.nodes.
    `-- canvasDisplayNodes(...) calls drawEdge(edge, scene, views, cell, endpointBounds).
        `-- Automatic placement uses grid regions, parent panes or conversation anchors.
